hero: Thirty coaches. Twenty seasons. One belt.
intro: Campus Kings is a long-haul online dynasty built around strategic gameplay, recruiting battles, and the thrill of college football. It's competitive without being joyless — the games matter, the group chat matters, and everybody's chasing the same thing.

pillars.title: The Belt is the prize
pillars.body: The Campus King Belt goes to whoever racks up the most national championships across the 20 accredited seasons. Rings matter most. That part doesn't change.

pillars.title: Playoff Points reward the climb
pillars.body: A parallel points race tracks the whole cycle — making the bracket, winning playoff games, reaching the Final Four, taking your conference. Being one of the five best coaches over 20 seasons should mean something too.

pillars.title: Nobody holds up the league
pillars.body: We advance on a 24-hour schedule at 8 PM ET. You need to be able to play between 7 PM and midnight ET. Games get scheduled in user chats, and admins rule on anything that stalls.

pillars.title: Games get streamed
pillars.body: User games get streamed. It keeps things transparent, keeps everybody honest, and gives the rest of the league something to watch on a Tuesday night.

how_it_works.text: The league advances every 24 hours at 8 PM ET. Know whether you have a game.
User chats get created for each matchup. Lead with your availability, be specific about time zones, tag your opponent.
Heisman difficulty, 5-minute quarters, default settings. Stream your user games. CPU games are simmed unless you want to play them.
Scores get logged, the site updates, and the recap and power rankings follow.

join.title: Getting in
join.body: New coaches need approval from LT or Curt. Team selections go through the league board to keep things competitively balanced. Bring good comms and a willingness to grind a rebuild — the rest sorts itself out.
